notes.title: First DLC for Trapped Summoner soon
notes.content: Very soon the first DLC for Trapped Summoner will be released. New levels will keep you even more in the dungeons of Taigren Castle. 6 new additional cards will allow you to plunge into the "old school" atmosphere fully. Monsters became bigger and their appetites became stronger. New traps and battles. And all this for free!

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: the best of Steam s rest this week
notes.content:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly selection of the 10 best under-reported new games on Steam – all of which have been released within the past seven days. If you find yourself paralysed by choice about what to buy or play, please allow me to be your unparalyser.

This week: Lovecraft on wheels, Life Is Strange, Inside and Superhot homages and the bizarre world of achievement farming.
